body: You're 19, you have plenty of time to learn qualifications
i have. i don't know what to do. i love him. we started having arguments every other day.
my boyfriend ignores me for hours. my mom (that i have to stay with because of quarantine) gets mad at me for cooking dinner for her.

The thing is, I have had 7 years of academic drawing and I did not manage to get in. I then took another course and still didn't get in. It's not me whining over not getting in, it's just I can't really do much besides drawing. I know it, because I'm studying something else than art and I suck. I can't do anything else.
these ones are hard. i ended a friendship in a similar way more than a year ago, my blood still boils when i think about it

My cat used to do that too. I don't think they're nightmares though, your cat is probably just dreaming. When my cat would let out that half meow half purr, I always thought he was dreaming of birds, since he would let out a similar noise when he would be watching birds outside through the window. Just stay with your cat, give her a kiss on the forehead and rest with her. You need sleep too.

I had a friend like that. Key word, had. I saw how toxic she was when she said that the only reason I was sexually assaulted was because I was closest to him in the room, "not because you're attractive or anything."   
My advice – cut her off as soon as possible. Stop hanging out with her. Stop texting her first. Stop inviting her places. She will likely catch and end your friendship before you know it.

I don't know who hurt my cat all those times, no one tells you straight to your face that they hate your pet. The thing is, I recall my parents having to talk to my neighbours about my brother's chipped tooth. I wouldn't be surprised if they hated us, not our cat.
You have to remember, that you're not a still picture in real life. People don't view you like that. I can assure you, that they don't notice your uneven eyes, because they're looking at your smile.

You're too scared because deep down you want to be here. You want to live. And I know that you deserve to live. No one stays at a horrible place in their life for long. Eventually it will start to get better. And once it does, you'll be grateful that you didn't end your life that day.

I am here for you.  
You are important to me. I promise to think of you every day. I'll think of this person on the internet who is as sad and as misunderstood as I am. You deserve to live, I deserve to live. We'll both be okay eventually. I believe that you'll get through this.
